connector.name: PayU Docs
connector.registryDescription: Search PayU docs, browse the payment integration catalog, and fetch production-ready code.
connector.summary: Hosted at ask-ai-mcp-710575177112.asia-south1.run.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the payu-intrepos account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Optional. Without a key you get anonymous-tier limits (30 req/min, 100 req/day). For higher limits, email ai-admin@payu.in to request an API key and paste it here.
